dslRule:
<!id: invert-equals-for-null-safe-getCompilationUnit>
<!description: Invert equals() comparison for potentially null results of getCompilationUnit() to prevent NullPointerException. Assumes the other argument is non-null.>
<!severity: ERROR>

$typeExpr.getCompilationUnit().equals($compilationUnitExpr)
=>
$compilationUnitExpr.equals($typeExpr.getCompilationUnit())
;;
summary: Invert an `equals()` method call where the receiver is the result of `getCompilationUnit()` to prevent NullPointerExceptions when `getCompilationUnit()` might return null.

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
